name: skill_edit
description: Edit an existing local skill — update its SKILL.md content and/or its tool list. Provide 'name' to identify the skill, then supply 'content' to overwrite the SKILL.md body and/or 'tools' to replace the tool list in skill.json. At least one of 'content' or 'tools' must be provided.

name.description: Name of the skill to edit

content.description: New markdown body for the SKILL.md file (replaces existing content)

tools.description: Replacement tool list for skill.json (replaces existing tools array)
